error_signature: Heater heater_bed not heating at expected rate
symptoms: Heated-bed temperature had large spikes and heating-rate shutdowns, especially during warm-up.
diagnosis: The owner replaced the bed thermistor. Temperature spikes disappeared but heating-rate errors remained.
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 LDO heated bed: unstable temperature, spikes, heater_bed not heating at expected rate. Replacing thermistor removed spikes but did not eliminate heating-rate shutdowns. The case is NOT fully resolved; do not claim thermistor replacement was a complete repair.

error_signature: Heater_bed not heating at expected rate
symptoms: Bed temperature sometimes fell during heat-up although a power indicator appeared active.
diagnosis: After discussing PID tuning and heater power limits, owner reported that changing maximum heater power to 0.6 seemed to resolve the issue.
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 heat bed intermittently cools despite heating request. Owner reported apparent improvement after reducing configured bed max_power to 0.6; heating became slower. Tentative report, not universal advice: power limits are hardware- and heater-dependent and need safety verification.

symptoms: Printer ran for months, then had intermittent hotend temperature failures and stopped mid-print. Thermistor and heater replacements and PID tuning did not initially fix the issue.
diagnosis: Owner bypassed thermistor wire passing through moving cable chain and reported stable hotend temperature; the wire path was the failure point.
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4r2 intermittent ADC out of range and verify_heater mid-print. Thermistor and heater replacements were insufficient. Bypassing thermistor wiring through cable chain stabilized readings and resolved failure in owner's test. Consider motion-dependent wire fatigue or routing, not automatically a bad thermistor.

symptoms: After homing, quad gantry leveling and probe calibration, nozzle still started printing millimeters above bed.
diagnosis: Owner confirmed that the additional Z-endstop calibration step had been omitted.
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 350 mm starts printing several millimeters too high even though PROBE_CALIBRATE and QGL appear correct. Owner confirmed omitted Z_ENDSTOP_CALIBRATE step. Differentiate probe offset calibration from independent Z endstop calibration.

error_signature: Toolhead digs into bed after BED_MESH_CALIBRATE
symptoms: Bed mesh completed, then print started in an incorrect location with nozzle striking the build plate; without mesh the print worked.
diagnosis: Owner found the bed-mesh zero reference configuration missing and reported success after adding a matching zero_reference_position.
hardware_variant: Clockwork 2, Afterburner, EB2209 CAN, Klicky probe
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 bed mesh leads to wrong first-print position and bed strike. Owner identified missing zero_reference_position configuration in bed_mesh and corrected it. This is a machine-safety problem: require stopping operation and verifying configuration before attempting a new print.

error_signature: X and Z endstops always show triggered
symptoms: Newly built printer could not home because X and Z appeared permanently triggered.
diagnosis: Owner needed a pull-up marker in X switch pin configuration and proper Cartographer probe installation/calibration.
hardware_variant: Siboor kit, CAN toolhead, Cartographer probe
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4r2 Siboor kit: X and Z endstop inputs permanently triggered, homing impossible. Owner solved via input pull-up configuration for X and proper Cartographer probe setup. Hardware-specific solution, do not transfer pin settings to unrelated probes.

error_signature: Hotend temperature falls when part-cooling fan activates
symptoms: Hotend held temperature without fan, but cooling fan at full speed caused rapid drop and printer shutdown.
diagnosis: Other members discussed silicone sock, heater capacity and PID tuning under fan load. No owner confirmation of any fix appears in source thread.
hardware_variant: 350 mm, Dragon High Flow hotend, Stealthburner
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 hotend thermal shutdown only when part-cooling fan runs at 100 percent. Discussion mentions possible airflow, silicone sock and PID tuning issues. No verified final fix. Present these only as inspection hypotheses rather than proven repair.

error_signature: MCU 'mcu' shutdown: ADC out of range
symptoms: New printer returned an ADC-out-of-range fault, with a very low extruder sensor reading.
diagnosis: Forum participant noticed the 14-pin toolhead connector was not fully engaged. Owner physically checked and confirmed that was the connection failure.
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 MCU shutdown ADC out of range. Owner confirmed 14-pin connector between toolhead and board was only partly seated. Open thermistor connection produced implausible negative temperature. Diagnose electrical connection before replacing components.

error_signature: Z probe stays OPEN despite optical indication
symptoms: CNC Tap V2 optical indicator changed state but Klipper probe/endstop input stayed open.
diagnosis: Owner reported functioning endstop after changing wiring and matching probe pin configuration on SB2209 CAN board.
hardware_variant: 350 mm, Clockwork 2, Stealthburner, SB2209 CAN and CNC Tap V2
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4r2 Tap V2 probe indicator changes but Klipper reports OPEN. Owner rerouted probe to endstop input and changed pin assignment on SB2209 CAN board. Pin-specific solution must not be used blindly with other controller or probe variants.

error_signature: Inconsistent Z probing; first measurement deviates about 0.2 to 0.4 mm
symptoms: Repeated bed probe measurements intermittently diverged despite swapping different probe hardware and tuning sampling settings.
diagnosis: Custom vinyl panel clips rubbed against linear rail carriages; removing enclosure panels eliminated the problem. Owner also suspected frame strain.
hardware_variant: Custom vinyl enclosure panels; probe variants changed
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4 repeated Z probe errors of 0.2 to 0.4 millimeters were due to custom enclosure panel clips rubbing on linear rail carriages; removing panels restored stable probing. A mechanical interference problem mimicked sensor calibration failure.

symptoms: PID tuning completed through 241 C but consistently failed at 242 C or above after overshooting the requested target.
diagnosis: A forum moderator diagnosed configured extruder temperature limits as too low. Owner acknowledged, but thread does not document a detailed subsequent test.
hardware_variant: Formbot Pro+ kit, Clockwork 2, Stealthburner, SB2209 RP2040 CAN board
retrieval_text: Voron 2.4r2 hotend PID tune works at 241 C, fails at 242 C and above with thermocouple reader fault. Forum moderator identified too-low configured temperature limit. Important: do not tell users to raise safety limits without verifying certified hardware ratings, sensor compatibility and actual target temperature.
